description: Review the visual and interaction design of a web UI from screenshots and code: hierarchy, spacing and alignment, typography, color and tokens, responsive behavior, states (empty, loading, error, hover, focus, disabled), consistency with a design system, and polish. Use when asked to critique, polish, or sanity-check a page, component, or Figma-to-code result, or to give a design-quality pass before release. Produces prioritized, actionable findings with concrete CSS/markup changes. Do not use for accessibility conformance (web-accessibility-review), rendering performance (react-performance), HTML/CSS syntax questions (web-html-css), or brand strategy.
